name: cimtk
description: Cyber Incident Management Toolkit assistants: exec briefings, public statements, retainer and focus group simulations, CTI coaching, supply chain incident navigation and tabletop exercise design.

interface.longDescription: CIMTK helps cyber incident managers and response leaders manage active incidents. It provides guided workflows for executive briefings, public communications, incident-response advisory reviews, threat-intelligence requirements, supply-chain incidents, staff-message review and tabletop exercise design. This skills-only plugin works with information supplied by the user and does not connect to external systems or perform technical response actions.
capabilities: Review incident material with a virtual retainer team
Review staff communications through focus groups
